svg.title: Offloaded to a bounded store, restored byte-identical
svg.desc: Soft flat drawing. An H800 GPU card with two kinds of block beside it: a grid of coral and white cells (attention KV) and a striped square (recurrent state). An arrow marked offload takes both into a box of fixed size, the bounded store capped at 1 GiB per GPU; an arrow marked restore brings both back. The restored blocks sit under the originals with the same pattern, joined by alignment lines. 48 of 48 restores read back byte-identical. The cell pattern is a symbol, not recorded data.
